full_judgment: 2. The plaintiff-opposite parties instituted Title Suit No. 465 of 1978 in the court of the 1st Munsif, Dhaka for declaration of title to the suit land and for recovery of khas possession by evicting the defendants therefrom on the allegations, inter alia, that the suit plot No. 118 along with plot Nos. 116 and 117 of mouja Kakrail originally belonged to the predecessor-in-interest of defendant Nos. 1-11; that plaintiff No. 1 was inducted as a tenant in the hut standing on CS Plot No. 117 and he adversely possessed plot No. 118 for more than 12 years and thereby acquired a good title by adverse possession therein; that defendant Nos. 12 and 13 on the basis of some false documents obtained an ex parte decree against the defendant Nos. 1-11 without impleading the plaintiffs.
